string.text:
A lead-lined metal box built around a trapped gravitational pocket, of such density that is compared to a black hole. Observations suggest these pockets form an interlinked network of some kind, as rather than crushing objects placed inside, they reappear undamaged at whichever pocket was most recently unsealed. Another observed effect is a marked increase in the density of the surrounding air, sufficient to impede both movement and respiration.
